Plot composition distributions

Source: R/plot_composition.R
plot_composition_distribution.Rd

Plot age or length compositions as distributions (proportion by bin), one panel per year, optionally overlaying the model-expected values. Setting aggregate = TRUE instead sums the compositions across years so that each fleet is summarized in a single panel.

plot_composition_distribution(
  dat,
  show_expected = TRUE,
  aggregate = FALSE,
  comp_type = NULL,
  fleet = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  direction = "v"
)

Arguments

dat

A tibble returned from convert_output() that contains composition data (see bigskate_lencomp), or composition data in any other format accepted by prepare_composition_data().

show_expected

Logical. TRUE/FALSE; overlay the expected values as lines. Ignored if dat contains no expected values. Default: TRUE

aggregate

Logical. TRUE/FALSE; aggregate compositions across years within each fleet. Years are weighted by their sample size when sample sizes are available. Default: FALSE

comp_type

String. Type of composition to keep when dat contains more than one. Options: "age", "length", or NULL (keep all). Default: NULL

fleet

Character or numeric vector. Fleet(s) to keep, matching either the fleet name (e.g., "Fishery_current") or the fleet name with its partition (e.g., "Fishery_current (retained)"). NULL keeps all fleets. Default: NULL

ncol

Number. Number of facet columns. NULL lets ggplot2 choose. Default: NULL

direction

String. Order of the panels: "v" fills panels down each column and then across, so consecutive years are stacked vertically and cohorts are easier to follow from panel to panel; "h" fills panels across each row.

Default: "v"

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Details

When compositions are sex-specific (both "female" and "male" values in the sex column), females are plotted above zero and males below zero. Bars show observed proportions and lines show expected proportions. Females and males are colored with the two ends of viridis::viridis(2, option = "viridis", end = 0.75) ("#440154" and "#5DC863"); add ggplot2::scale_fill_manual() and ggplot2::scale_color_manual() to the returned plot to use other colors.

If more than one fleet is plotted without aggregating, panels are created for every fleet and year combination; use fleet to focus on one fleet at a time.

Equivalent plots in other packages

r4ss: r4ss::SSplotComps() subplot 1 (by year) and subplot 21 (aggregated across years).

See also

prepare_composition_data(), plot_composition_bubble(), plot_composition_residuals(), plot_composition_sexratio(), plot_composition_francis()

Examples

# Observations only
plot_composition_distribution(bigskate_lencomp, fleet = "WCGBTS", show_expected = FALSE)


# Observed and expected
plot_composition_distribution(bigskate_lencomp, fleet = "Triennial")


# All fleets aggregated across years
plot_composition_distribution(bigskate_lencomp, aggregate = TRUE)
